title: ICAI Announces Hosting of Multipurpose Empanelment Form (MEF) 2026-27
content:
# ICAI Announces Hosting of Multipurpose Empanelment Form (MEF) 2026-27

Ek important update hai for all practicing Chartered Accountants! The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) has announced the hosting of the Multipurpose Empanelment Form (MEF) for the year 2026-27. This is a crucial step for CAs and firms looking to secure professional assignments.

Here are the key details you need to know:

*   **What:** The Professional Development Committee (PDC) of ICAI has made the Multipurpose Empanelment Form (MEF) for 2026-27 available.
*   **Where to Access:** The MEF 2026-27 can be accessed online at the official portal: `https://meficai.org/`.
*   **Last Date for Submission:** The deadline for online submission of the MEF 2026-27 is **August 29, 2026**.
*   **Important Advisory:** Members are strongly advised to thoroughly review the 'Advisory for Multipurpose Empanelment Form (MEF) 2026-27' before proceeding with the form submission. This advisory outlines eligibility criteria, the filing procedure, important parameters for credit, and details regarding Unique Code Number (UCN).
*   **Purpose of MEF:** The information furnished through the MEF is shared by ICAI with various authorities like RBI, NABARD, CRCS, and others for the purpose of empanelment for professional assignments.
*   **Login/Registration:** If you are a returning applicant who registered for MEF in previous year(s), you can log in using your existing credentials. First-time applicants need to register themselves for MEF 2026-27 at `https://meficai.org/register`.

Be sure to complete your submission well before the due date to avoid any last-minute technical glitches.

## Read the Official Document
*   [Download the Official Notification/Circular here](https://www.icai.org/post/announcement-hosting-mef-2026-27)
